notes: All 20 Devin sessions were invoked exactly once in the frozen order. Evaluators ran only after their corresponding sessions closed and their output was not exposed to later runs.

prelaunch_setup_incidents.description: Initial launcher staging placed its log inside the runner-required-empty output directory; the runner refused before container start. The staging paths were quarantined and the run was then launched once correctly.
